name: Aananda Lakshmi Spinning Mills Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2013, Aananda Lakshmi Spinning Mills Ltd manufactures and trades 
textile-related products and also deals in real estate.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2][3]
ALSML is engaged in manufacturing cotton, blended polyester, polyester viscose, and other yarns, with production split evenly between cotton and polyester. The company has also entered the real estate sector, focusing on land development, plotting, and sales, converting a portion of its land into stock-in-trade for this purpose.

cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -23.9% over past five years.
